description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Greenwarden of Murasa and another nontoken creature, adding {1}{W}.
Cast Continue? by paying {1}{W}, returning Greenwarden of Murasa and at least one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, it triggers, returning Continue? from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
